meta.title: Cornerstone Develop | Custom software, data and cybersecurity in Guayaquil
meta.description: Cornerstone Develop, David Alvarado's development studio in Guayaquil, Ecuador: web systems, mobile and desktop apps, databases, cloud and OWASP security audits.
meta.ogDescription: Code that holds your business together: custom software, data and cybersecurity from Guayaquil, Ecuador.

hero.lead: Custom software, mobile and desktop apps, databases, cloud and security audits for companies that can't afford to stop.
hero.side: See what's behind every screen: clean code, organised data and security reviewed before every release.

intro.body: A cornerstone is the first block of a building: everything else lines up with it. That's what we do with your company's technology: software, data and security on a solid foundation.
intro.who: Cornerstone Develop is the development studio of David Alvarado, a full-stack developer specialised in security, based in Guayaquil, Ecuador.
intro.symbol: Our symbol: a </> code tag built from stone blocks. The yellow block in the corner is the cornerstone — the stone every piece of software is built on.

pillars.title: Software development
pillars.text: Web systems, mobile and desktop apps built around the way your company works.

pillars.title: Data and databases
pillars.text: Design, migration and optimisation of your data, with reports that update themselves.

pillars.title: Cybersecurity
pillars.text: Pentesting, code review and hardening so your system withstands real attacks.

dev.title: Software that fits your company
dev.lead: We don't sell templates. We learn how your team works and build the tool that fits, with clean code any developer can maintain.
dev.codeCaption: Sample snippet: issuing an electronic invoice.

services.title: Web systems
services.text: ERPs, customer portals and admin dashboards.

services.title: Mobile apps
services.text: Orders, inventory and collections from your phone, with offline mode.

services.title: Desktop
services.text: Point of sale, warehouse and invoicing, connected to printers and scanners.

services.title: APIs and integrations
services.text: We connect your systems to each other and to payment gateways, email or messaging.

services.title: Cloud and DevOps
services.text: Hosting, backups and automated deployments without relying on a single PC.

services.title: Support and upgrades
services.text: Maintenance, new features and monitoring for systems you already have.

data.title: Your data, in order and in sight
data.lead: Your company's information is worth more when it's organised, backed up and ready to drive decisions.

points.title: Database design
points.text: Clear models, the right indexes and automatic backups.

points.title: Lossless migrations
points.text: From Excel, Access or legacy systems to SQL Server, PostgreSQL or MySQL.

points.title: Reports and dashboards
points.text: Power BI connected to your real data, updated with no manual work.

security.title: We find the flaws before an attacker does
security.lead: We audit the systems we build and the ones you already run in production. We only test systems owned by the client, with a defined scope and prior written authorization.

services.title: Web pentesting
services.text: We test your application the way an attacker would, with a defined scope and written authorization.

services.title: Code review
services.text: We look for injections, logic flaws and exposed secrets before production.

services.title: Hardening
services.text: Servers, databases and Cloudflare configured to reduce the attack surface.

services.title: Training
services.text: Threat modeling and secure development workshops for your team.

projects.title: Real work, in production
projects.lead: Products we built that are already live: you can open them and try them right now.

nudo.title: Nudo
nudo.desc: Invoices, expenses and deductions in one place: pull receipts from your inbox, verify them with the SRI and estimate your income-tax rebate.

unisono.title: Unísono
unisono.desc: Lyrics, chords and keys for worship teams, synced live and available offline.

process.title: Progress every week, not just at the end

steps.title: Design

steps.title: Development

steps.title: Audit

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: We go live, train your team and stay available.
